g.text: Core · protocol client, commands, ChatGPT bridge
`python -m src.main` · pick server, player name, how many clients to spawn
`src/sof/server_list.py` · TCP master list, then a UDP info probe per server, called by `main`
`src/sof/keys.py` + pygame · keyboard or gamepad → usercmd fields
`src/ui/chat_gui.py` · tkinter chat and RCON windows, tk or pygame sounds
`src/sof/client.py` · endpoints and players, `~/.config` settings, RCON packets, main loop
`src/sof/connection.py` · hand-built netchan: seq/ack, reliable queue, fragments, keepalive
`src/sof/player.py` · one usercmd per tick: viewangles, move flags, msec
`src/sof/commands.py` · single command table shared by terminal and chat
`src/sof/chat_bridge.py` · chat line → [setting] or GPT prompt — reply chunked to 150 chars, paced
`src/gpt/ask_question.py` · undetected Chrome types into chat.openai.com, scrapes the growing answer
`sof-server-lister/` · vendored and not imported — PyQt4 server browser (oldpysof)
`~/.config/config.json` · RCON password per ip:port + audio and notification flags
`~/.config/sof-gpt-chromium` · Chrome profile holding the ChatGPT login (path hardcoded)
`new_venv/` · 98 MB local venv, untracked — not part of the app
SoF game server · UDP, protocol spoken by `connection.py` and `packets/`
`chat.openai.com` · web UI only, no API key anywhere in the repo
Chrome/Chromium + chromedriver · major version probed from the OS at import
